1	"""Typed model objects, values, and the predicate expression AST.
     2	
     3	A campaign names every type once; `build_types` resolves the (possibly forward
     4	referencing, always acyclic) graph into `Type` objects.  Predicates arrive as
     5	typed JSON expression arrays and are compiled once into Python closures that
     6	evaluate a lexical environment of module inputs and `all` bindings.
     7	"""
     8	from .errors import InvalidCampaign
     9	from .regex import compile_pattern

    11	MAX_NAME = 32
    12	MAX_DEPTH = 256
    13	
    14	
    15	def _need(condition, message):
    16	    if not condition:
    17	        raise InvalidCampaign(message)
    18	
    19	
    20	def _integer(value):
    21	    if type(value) is not int:
    22	        raise InvalidCampaign("expected an integer")
    23	    return value
    24	
    25	
    26	def _identifier(value):
    27	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
    28	        raise InvalidCampaign("expected an identifier")
    29	    if len(value) > MAX_NAME:
    30	        raise InvalidCampaign("identifier too long")
    31	    head = value[0]
    32	    if not (head.isalpha() and head.isascii() or head == "_"):
    33	        raise InvalidCampaign("invalid identifier")
    34	    for char in value[1:]:
    35	        if not (char.isalnum() and char.isascii() or char == "_"):
    36	            raise InvalidCampaign("invalid identifier")
    37	    return value

    45	class Type(object):
    46	    """Base class of the Eywa type lattice."""
    47	
    48	    decl = None
    49	
    50	    @staticmethod
    51	    def inner(type):
    52	        """Look past any type aliases to get the inner type."""
    53	        while isinstance(type, Alias):
    54	            type = type.type
    55	        return type

    57	
    58	class Void(Type):
    59	    """No value at all."""
    60	
    61	
    62	class Bool(Type):
    63	    """True or false."""
    64	
    65	
    66	class Char(Type):
    67	    """One Latin-1 character, including NUL."""
    68

    70	class Int(Type):
    71	    """An unsigned integer of at most `bits` bits."""
    72	
    73	    def __init__(self, bits: int = 32):
    74	        self.bits = bits
    75	
    76	    @property
    77	    def width(self) -> int:
    78	        bits = self.bits
    79	        if bits <= 8:
    80	            return 1
    81	        if bits <= 16:
    82	            return 2
    83	        if bits <= 32:
    84	            return 4
    85	        return 8
    86	
    87	    @property
    88	    def limit(self) -> int:
    89	        return 1 << self.bits

    92	class String(Type):
    93	    """A bounded Latin-1 C string."""
    94	
    95	    def __init__(self, maxsize: int = 0):
    96	        if maxsize < 0:
    97	            raise InvalidCampaign("invalid string type")
    98	        self.maxsize = maxsize
    99	        self.char_type = Char()

   102	class Enum(Type):
   103	    """One of a fixed list of strings."""
   104	
   105	    def __init__(self, name: str, values):
   106	        self.name = name
   107	        self.values = list(values)
   108	
   109	    @property

   114	class Array(Type):
   115	    """An ordered fixed-length list."""
   116	
   117	    def __init__(self, element_type: Type, size: int):
   118	        self.element_type = element_type
   119	        self.size = size

   122	class Struct(Type):
   123	    """A record with an ordered field list."""
   124	
   125	    def __init__(self, name: str, fields=None):
   126	        self.name = name
   127	        self.fields = dict(fields) if fields else {}

   130	class Alias(Type):
   131	    """A transparent value and layout alias."""
   132	
   133	    def __init__(self, name: str, type: Type, description=None):
   134	        self.name = name
   135	        self.type = type
   136	        self.description = description

   139	def underlying(type: Type) -> Type:
   140	    """Strip aliases; declarations keep their name but values do not."""
   141	    while isinstance(type, Alias):
   142	        type = type.type
   143	    return type
